description:
On her twentieth birthday, Violet, a young lady from a fallen noble family, is sold by her gambling-addicted father to a man she has never met. Expecting disappointment, she is shocked when a tall, handsome knight appears at the wedding—who is even younger than she is. Immediately after the ceremony, her young husband departs for the battlefield. 

Three years later, he returns as a mature man and expresses his desire to become a true husband to her. 

This story follows the whirlwind "marriage first, romance later" journey of the younger husband, Aldric, and his wife, Violet.

**Original Webtoon:**
